about: Golden cases for toExpenseInput (@retrospend/domain/expense-input) and for what a create books from it. Every path that creates an expense runs these: the web's tRPC create, v1 POST /expenses, and later the device engine. body is the create body. instants is the start of body.date in each zone the request can carry (Buenos Aires is UTC-3 all year, so its midnight is 03:00Z; UTC is 00:00Z). booked is what the row stores, as decimal text compared as numbers. Rates are units per USD (rates, all dated 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z). Expected values are derived by hand in each case's derivation, never read from an implementation. A create books status FINALIZED, direction OUT and pricingSource MANUAL.

cases.name: ARS home: USD 100 books the blue rate on the first day of a month
cases.derivation: No type: the ARS default is blue. USD leg 1, ARS blue 1545, so homeRate 1545 and homeAmount 100 x 1545 = 154500.00. 2026-04-01 is April 1 midnight in the zone: 03:00Z in Buenos Aires, 00:00Z in UTC.

cases.name: ARS home: a typed EUR rate books custom on the last day of a month
cases.derivation: Typed 1 EUR = 1500 ARS, EUR 1030: homeAmount 1030 x 1500 = 1545000. The EUR leg comes through the home leg (ARS blue 1545): 1 EUR = 1500 / 1545 USD, so EUR per USD = 1545 / 1500 = 1.03 and the USD value of EUR 1030 is 1030 / 1.03 = 1000. 2026-03-31 midnight: 03:00Z in Buenos Aires, 00:00Z in UTC.

cases.name: USD home: EUR 50 at the official type, a control with no second currency
cases.derivation: EUR official 0.8 per USD is 1.25 USD per EUR; the home leg is USD (1). homeRate 1.25, homeAmount 50 x 1.25 = 62.50, USD value 62.50, exchangeRate 0.8. 2026-04-01 midnight: 03:00Z in Buenos Aires, 00:00Z in UTC.

cases.name: JPY home: a tie at 1257.5 rounds to the even 1258
cases.derivation: JPY official 125 per USD, USD entry: homeRate 125, USD 10.06 x 125 = 1257.5 exactly, a tie at JPY's 0 decimals; half to even picks 1258 (1257 is odd). USD value 10.06. 2026-03-31 midnight: 03:00Z in Buenos Aires, 00:00Z in UTC.

cases.name: KWD home: a KWD amount keeps its 3 decimals
cases.derivation: KWD official 0.25 per USD is 4 USD per KWD. The entry is in the home currency: homeRate 1, homeAmount 12.345 (KWD has 3 decimals), USD value 12.345 x 4 = 49.38, exchangeRate 0.25. 2026-04-01 midnight: 03:00Z in Buenos Aires, 00:00Z in UTC.
